Technical field

Embodiments of the present invention are related to semiconductor integrated circuit.

Background technology

Programmable logic device is the semiconductor integrated circuit that can rewrite circuit after chip manufacturing.Programmable logic Equipment has multiple wirings, and selected 2 wirings in these wirings is made electrically to become connection status or non-company each other Connect state.Switching circuit is used in order to which selected 2 wirings is controlled such that become connection status or notconnect state, The switching circuit possesses transistor and memory.The memory can be programmed electrically, and information based on programming, transistor is led Logical/cut-off switching.

Furthermore it is known that have using the electro-resistance element of 2 terminals as memory element, realized using the memory element it is above-mentioned The cross-point type electro-resistance element array of switching circuit.Above-mentioned electro-resistance element has 2 electrodes and is located at this 2 electricity Resistance change layer between pole.By voltage as defined in application above-mentioned 2 electrodes, becoming the resistance states of resistance change layer Change, 2 interelectrode resistance can be switched to low resistance state or high resistance state.

When electro-resistance element is programmed, it is necessary to suitably control the size of the program voltage applied to electrode and above-mentioned The application time of program voltage.In addition, control flows to electric current in electro-resistance element in the application of program voltage Size is also important.It has been known that there is partly leading with the circuit that the electric current for flowing through electro-resistance element is controlled in programming as a result, Body integrated circuit.

When by cross-point type electro-resistance element array program, apply without selected electro-resistance element than selected The small voltage of the electro-resistance element selected.This be in order to prevent without selected electro-resistance element programming interference (put Position (set) interference resets (reset) interference).

In addition, make the voltage of the resistance variations of electro-resistance element, it is different according to electro-resistance element, and also according to Switch periods, i.e. electro-resistance element are from the situation that high resistance state variation is low resistance state or from low resistance state variation The situation of high resistance state and it is different.Therefore, it is difficult to it operates while predicting the next voltage for making resistance variations.If expand Make the excursion of the voltage of resistance variations, it is likely that be applied with than selected to no selected electro-resistance element The small voltage of electro-resistance element in the case of programming interference also occurs.Even if become on by the resistance for making electro-resistance element The mode of programming interference does not also occur for the excursion expansion of the voltage of change, has no knowledge about at present.

The content of the invention

The object of the present invention is to provide a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit that can inhibit that programming interference occurs.
